he: פסק הדין רע"פ  1072/16 עוסק בבקשה רשות לערעור על גזר דינו של בג ״ צ לערעורים ב-ע 89/14 מיום 17.6.2015, בו התקבל ערעור המשיבה (מדינת חיפה בדמות התובע הצבאי הראשי) על זיכויה של המבקשת (נאור בניזרי) בבג ״ צ המחוזי, וב-ע 51/15 מיום 10.1.2016, בו התקבל בחלקו ערעורה של המבקשת על גזר דינה.
en: The judgment in case number R.A. 1072/16 concerns a request for permission to appeal the decision of the Military Court of Appeals in case number C.A. 89/14, dated June 17, 2015, in which the appeal by the respondent (the State of Haifa, represented by the Chief Military Prosecutor) was upheld, overturning the acquittal of the petitioner (Naor Benizri) in the District Military Court, and in case number C.A. 51/15, dated January 10, 2016, in which the petitioner's appeal against her sentence was partially upheld.

en: The judgment in case number 536/16 concerns a request for permission to appeal the decision of the Military Court of Appeals in case number 89/14, dated June 17, 2015, in which the appeal by the respondent (the State of Israel, represented by the Chief Military Prosecutor) was upheld, overturning the acquittal of the petitioner (Rachel Benizri) by the District Military Court. The judgment also addresses case number 51/15, dated January 10, 2016, in which the petitioner's appeal against her sentence was partially upheld.
